clips.title: Link two tasks
clips.summary: Drag from the end of one bar to the start of another, so the second task waits for the first.
steps: Point at the first task’s bar: a small dot appears at each end.
Drag from the dot at its end to the start of the task that has to wait.
Let go: the arrow is drawn and the later work moves to make room.

clips.title: Add work from the library
clips.summary: Drag a library card onto the plan; Remy says where it fits, and its tasks and links go in with it.
steps: Open the Library tab and grab a card.
Drag it onto the plan: the line shows where it lands.
Let go: take Remy’s place, or tie it in where you let go.
The note says what moved and why; Undo takes it out again.
Close the panel: its tasks sit under one heading, with outline numbers.
Links tie it in: it waits for the flooring, and the doors wait for it.

clips.title: Save work to the library
clips.summary: Select tasks in the plan, right-click, Save to library, name it, and Save.
steps: Click a task, then Shift-click another to select both.
Right-click them and choose “Save to library…”.
Name it in the short form and pick the folder it goes in.
Save: it is in the Library tab, ready to drag into any plan.

clips.title: Watch the plan with a rule
clips.summary: Open the Watch tab, pick a recipe under Rules, and Add it: the rule reads as a sentence.
steps: Open the Watch tab on the right.
Go to Rules: under your rules are recipes other teams keep.
Press Add on the one you want, or Adjust it first.
It joins your rules and reads as a sentence: when, if, then.

clips.title: Invite someone into a conversation
clips.summary: Open a private conversation, press Invite and pick a project member: they read it from then on.
steps: In the Remy tab, open the conversation from the list.
Private conversations show a lock: only you and Remy read them.
Press Invite and pick a project member.
They read all of it from then on, earlier messages included; the line under the title says who reads it.
